variant.briefing:
Hey,

XenoThreat just raided one of our convoys and made off with a bunch of supplies. I’m not sure exactly where they took them, but I know they have a cache of stolen cargo not too far away. If I had to guess, that’s exactly where they took them. 

The spot is [Location]. Need someone to go there, grab the goods inside, and bring them to [Destination]. The outpost is a little ways away from their main operations hub. Normally, there’s fewer forces there than the main outpost, but don’t think this will be a walk in the park. Just be smart and prepared. 

Be safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
